# Verification block 1: resolve partner contact(s) and find driving license file(s)

# --- Login phone and resolve partner ---
phone_pw = [x['password'] for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if x['account_name']=='phone'][0]
phone_login = apis.phone.login(username='7826309761', password=phone_pw)
phone_token = phone_login['access_token']

partner_contacts = []
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
while True:
    res = apis.phone.search_contacts(access_token=phone_token, relationship='partner', page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    # API returned list in earlier runs
    page_items = res
    if isinstance(res, dict):
        page_items = res.get('success', res.get('contacts', []))
    if not page_items:
        break
    partner_contacts.extend(page_items)
    page_index += 1

print('Partner contacts (from phone relationship=partner):', [(c['first_name'], c['last_name'], c.get('email')) for c in partner_contacts])
print('Count:', len(partner_contacts))

# --- Login file_system and find driving license file(s) ---
file_pw = [x['password'] for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if x['account_name']=='file_system'][0]
fs_login = apis.file_system.login(username='cod.smith@gmail.com', password=file_pw)
fs_token = fs_login['access_token']

# Search for files that likely correspond to driving license
all_license_files = apis.file_system.show_directory(
    access_token=fs_token,
    directory_path='/',
    substring='license',
    entry_type='files',
    recursive=True
)

# Filter to driving license
matched_paths = [p for p in all_license_files if ('driving' in p.lower() and 'license' in p.lower())]
print('License files found containing driving+license:', matched_paths)
print('Matched file count:', len(matched_paths))

# Ensure each matched path can be shown
file_details = []
for p in matched_paths:
    f = apis.file_system.show_file(file_path=p, access_token=fs_token)
    file_details.append({
        'path': f['path'],
        'file_id': f['file_id'],
        'updated_at': f['updated_at']
    })

print('Matched file details:', file_details)

# --- Build email payload ---
if len(partner_contacts) != 1:
    print('AMBIGUITY: expected exactly 1 partner contact, found', len(partner_contacts))

recipient_email = partner_contacts[0]['email'] if partner_contacts else None
partner_first = partner_contacts[0]['first_name'] if partner_contacts else None

subject = 'Driving license'
body = f"Hi {partner_first},\n\nAttached is my driving license.\n\n— Cody"
attachment_file_paths = matched_paths

# Verification table
print('\nVERIFICATION TABLE')
print('Recipient | Source phone contact email')
print(f"{recipient_email} | {recipient_email}")
print('Attachment paths | Source file_system paths')
for p in attachment_file_paths:
    print(f"{p} | {p}")
print('Email subject:', subject)
print('Email body preview:', body)

partner_email = 'ka_ball@gmail.com'
subject = 'Driving license'
body = "Hi Katherine,\n\nAttached is my driving license.\n\n— Cody"
attachment_paths = ['/home/cody/documents/personal/identity/driving_license.pdf']

resp = apis.gmail.send_email(
    email_addresses=[partner_email],
    subject=subject,
    body=body,
    access_token=gmail_token,
    attachment_file_paths=attachment_paths,
    file_system_access_token=fs_token
)
print(resp)
